researchNotes: Formal Phase 3 complete against hashed requirements, COMPLEX19 assessment and Dara data review. No new dependencies assumed. No application changes or runtime tests; design recommendations remain proposals. See research-notes.md.

requirementCoverage.FR-1: Editable working code draft separate from immutable base; new explicit authority/draft generation contract; saved invalid/never-validated manual checkpoints remain retained; page-level dirty buffer survives tab/background reads
requirementCoverage.FR-2: Exact selected immutable Studio artifact download; portable export outside first slice; resolved secrets excluded
requirementCoverage.FR-3: Existing schema/AST/reference validator; no manual-source AI repair; both generated and manual preparation must await explicit confirmation, superseding current auto-confirm publication
requirementCoverage.FR-4: Retain byte-aligned originalText and step order; actual operations summarize edited behavior without claiming English equivalence
requirementCoverage.FR-5: Immutable revision ID, server artifact hash, truthful manual parent/actor lineage and accepted execution pin
requirementCoverage.FR-6: CAS across save/validation/publication/confirmation/readiness; draft counter model left to architect; execute request names exact intended confirmed revision/hash/freshness tuple and never silently retargets to a newer confirmation
requirementCoverage.FR-7: Working, validated candidate and confirmed labels; download pins selected persisted revision, not unsaved text; last-run source is resolved through its accepted execution revision even after new confirmations
requirementCoverage.FR-8: CSI-scoped read/write/download; reference/secret restrictions; current runtime compatibility gate
requirementCoverage.NFR-1: Preserve existing allowlist and operation-only child runtime; no full TypeScript execution
requirementCoverage.NFR-2: Concurrency tests required for new authority-generation predicates; no runtime correctness claim here
requirementCoverage.NFR-3: Existing MUI multiline control is dependency-free option; keyboard/focus/diagnostics acceptance must be verified during implementation
requirementCoverage.CON-1: Bounded language retained; proposed editor explicitly supersedes ADR-002 section 30 only for working/candidate views
requirementCoverage.CON-2: Checklist first; explicit source mode transition and confirmation; no runtime AI
requirementCoverage.CON-3: Existing React/MUI/API client/MSW and backend/runner; no new dependency preselected
requirementCoverage.CON-5: No Python; standalone export/import/Git/rollback/history UI outside first slice

dataReviewAlignment.recommendedCounter: Separate codeDraftRevision with explicit authoring mode
dataReviewAlignment.manualWorkRetention: Append-only bounded unvalidated manual checkpoints, including invalid source; preserve latest saved checkpoint across mode transitions; no silent regeneration
dataReviewAlignment.candidateIdentity: One immutable revision per distinct captured preparation request; replay same request idempotently, do not coalesce independent authorship on equal artifactHash
dataReviewAlignment.migration: Extend captured-attempt infrastructure for GENERATED_COMPILE/MANUAL_VALIDATION; reconcile V18/V24 content uniqueness and staged V19 require-request cutover with drained publishers; do not bypass captured request invariant
dataReviewAlignment.immutability: Restore whole-row protection excluding only write-once first confirmation, or equivalent complete negative-test coverage; new fields must be protected
dataReviewAlignment.lineage: Manual parent distinct from incremental baseline; same test/CSI ownership enforced by composite foreign keys
dataReviewAlignment.download: Preserve exact artifact content and code strings, hash canonical artifact only, separate metadata envelope; avoid promising original HTTP serialization bytes

supplementalAlignment.reviewReason: Final QA provenance housekeeping after requirements/architecture/spec iteration 2 amendments. Original Phase 3 inputAlignment hashes and timestamp preserve the earlier research input provenance; this entry records later review rather than retroactively claiming the amendments were studied initially.
reviewedAmendments: Existing authoring/Steps/context/config writers compare complete caller expected freshness F with persisted state, extending safeguards to existing entry points.

Generated/manual worker success/failure/deadline/cancellation/abandonment settlement uses immutable captured request identity/F rather than unauthenticated client-body freshness; stale sweeper work cannot clear newer manual candidate/request.
Optional preparation failure does not revoke unchanged compatible confirmed readiness; compileStatus alone is not readiness authority.
Ordered two-request page Save reports partial failure, preserves local source and blocks Validate/Run until resolved.
AT-6 expands existing writer and stale settlement race coverage without adding a cancellation product feature.
supplementalAlignment.outcome: Later amendments are consistent with the existing native immutable revision, separate codeDraftRevision, complete concurrency audit, captured-event identity and exact confirmation/execution recommendations. No new dependency or runtime capability required. Implementation race evidence remains outstanding.
